D1.topic: set_freq(f < 18.454 kHz) on CLK6/7 (e.g. 10 kHz, 15 kHz)
D1.facts: Lowest CLK6/7 output = 600 MHz / 254 / 128 = 18454 Hz (MS6/7 even 6..254, R<=128, VCO>=600 MHz). 10 kHz is unreachable.
options: (a) reject: return 1, write nothing, keep clk_freq[clk] (matches CLK7 non-integer reject)
(b) clamp to SI5351_CLKOUT67_MIN_FREQ (18454 Hz -> MS 254, R 128, VCO 600 MHz) and return 0 (matches CLK0-5 clamp style)
(c) clamp and return a distinct non-zero code
D1.test_accepts: (a) or (b)/(c) as long as reg90 is even 6..254, pllb_freq in 600..900 MHz, output >= 18454 Hz

D2.facts: freq 0 reaches pllb_freq % freq (SIGFPE). Without a peer it reaches multisynth67_calc and writes MS6_P1 = 0. CLK0-5 set_freq(0) currently clamps to 500 kHz MS and enables the output (MNB-INFO only, not locked).
D2.test_accepts: any, as long as there is no crash and no invalid reg90/91 value

D3.facts: SI5351_MULTISYNTH_MAX_FREQ = 225 MHz; datasheet/AN619 max output is 200 MHz.
options: (a) clamp to 200 MHz (DIVBY4, PLL 800 MHz, a=32) and return 0
(b) reject with return 1 and no writes
D3.test_accepts: either; asserts realized <= 200 MHz and stored clk_freq <= 200 MHz

D4.topic: set_freq_manual with an illegal MS ratio (5, 6.667, 7)
D4.facts: AN619 valid ratios: 4, 6, 8, (8+1/1048575 .. 2048]. set_freq_manual's contract is 'track settings yourself'.
options: (a) return 1 without writing MS (keep PLL write?)
(b) round to nearest legal ratio (6 or 8) and return the realized-freq error some other way
D4.test_accepts: (a) with no MS0 block written, or any written MS0 ratio that is legal. NOTE: master also writes the PLL before validating; whether a rejected call may still change the PLL is part of this decision

D5.facts: XTAL_CL=00b is 'Reserved. Do not select this option.' (AN619 Reg 183). Reset default is 11b (10 pF).
options: (a) map 0PF to 6 pF (01b, smallest legal, closest to the request)

D6.facts: PLL input range 10-40 MHz (AN619.txt:94); XTAL 25/27 MHz (DS). With 5 MHz, VCO 600 MHz needs ratio 120 > 90: no legal configuration exists.
options: (a) init() returns false / set_ref_freq rejects < 10 MHz
(b) clamp feedback a to 90 (recompute a after the clamp) -> VCO 450 MHz, still below VCO_MIN
(c) accept but never write an out-of-range feedback block
D6.test_accepts: any policy where no PLLA/PLLB block with ratio outside 15..90 is written. (b) passes this test but leaves the VCO at 450 MHz (out of spec): flag if chosen
